create.name: Ariel Spilsbury
create.bio:
Ariel Spilsbury teaches the sacred feminine and founded the 13 Moon Mystery School, a programme of initiation into the feminine mysteries built around thirteen archetypal faces of the goddess. Her teaching blends myth, ceremony, chant, sound, sacred geometry and movement, and treats each student as a priestess or priest in the making rather than a follower. She created the 13 Moon Oracle, a deck of 39 archetypal cards, and she personally trained the school's focalizers, who are ordained by her to carry the work on.

The school now sits within a non-profit sanctuary she set up, with the aim of building a physical temple to the divine feminine in the San Francisco Bay Area. Through it she offers four recorded online courses: an audio series on feminine alchemy, and video courses on inter-dimensional sound, sacred geometry and the oracle archetypes. Members and visitors can also join regular free online circles held by the Sanctuary's community, draw a card from an online version of the oracle, and receive her short guidebook for those starting out on the priestess path.

courses.title: Feminine Alchemy
courses.description: A seven-part recorded audio series in which Ariel works with silence, synchronicity, the moon as a guide and the heroine's journey, with exercises and supporting notes. The Sanctuary describes it as her own favourite of her courses.

courses.title: Inter-Dimensional Sound
courses.description: A recorded video course on sound as a tool for inner change, drawing on Ariel's long practice as a sound priestess. The Sanctuary notes that audio quality varies in some of the videos.

courses.title: Sacred Geometry
courses.description: Recorded workshop sessions exploring the geometric symbols behind the 13 Moon Oracle and how to use them in practice, combining mantra, mudra and colour.

courses.title: 13 Moon Oracle Course
courses.description: A video series in which Ariel, who designed the deck, talks through each of its 39 archetypal cards in turn. It is meant for people who already own or use the 13 Moon Oracle.

free_resources.title: 13 Moon Oracle Online Deck
free_resources.description: A free interactive version of her oracle deck on the Sanctuary's site, where visitors draw a single card and read about its archetype.

free_resources.title: Guidebook for a Modern Priestess
free_resources.description: A short digital guide by Ariel for people beginning on the priestess path, sent free to those who join the Sanctuary's newsletter.
